name: calculate
description: Evaluate arithmetic, scientific math, statistics, algebra, matrices, calculus, and unit conversions.

expression.description: Math expression: square root -> sqrt(x); power -> a^b; factorial -> n!; sine -> sin(x); mean -> mean([a,b]); derivative -> diff(expr,x); integral -> integrate(expr,x,a,b); convert units -> 5 km to miles. Copy existing symbolic expressions exactly including parentheses.

name: unsupported
description: Reject requests unrelated to mathematics, such as weather, greetings, news, or programming. Also use when no calculation is specified.
